exposure: employment status of head of household
travel time from home to hospital
outcome: opportunity cost of work loss due to delivery
cohort: 384 postpartum mothers and their husbands/heads of household discharged from Manipal Teaching Hospital and Western Regional Hospital, Pokhara, Nepal
finding: Hidden costs associated with hospital-based delivery were substantial, averaging 243.4 USD for normal deliveries and 321.6 USD for C-sections, with significant associations found between higher costs and various socio-demographic and delivery-related factors.
mod_finding: C-section deliveries were significantly associated with higher hidden costs compared to normal deliveries.
